lines.text: Dockentra WMS runs the whole warehouse, and gives every client their own portal.
It's built to connect to a client's Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, eBay or WooCommerce store.
Orders come in from the store, or straight from the portal, in a few taps.
On the floor, the picker scans the tote, the location and the product.
Packing is scanned item by item, so the parcel matches the order.
The software builds the shipment record and the carrier label.
At the courier handover, every parcel is scanned again, so you know exactly what left the building.
Clients see every shipment's status, right up to the handover.
Every operation is logged and billed automatically.
The warehouse drafts the invoice, and the client sees the month's estimate.
Clients never see each other's data.
The software is built and tested, and our warehouse is opening in Limerick.

endLine.text: This is Dockentra: fulfilment for small sellers, powered by software we built ourselves.
